description: Aroha task-mandate v2 conformance vectors. A v2 signature is Ed25519(privateKey, UTF-8(JCS({"mandate": <body>, "purpose": "aroha.task-mandate/v2", "v": 2}))), base64url without padding; a token is base64url(JSON({v: 2, mandate, signature})). v1 tokens omit v and sign sortKeys/JSON.stringify of the body. tokens[].expected is verifyTaskMandate(token, keys[signer].publicKey, expectedGrantee, {now: verifyAt}); narrowing[].expectedReason is checkTaskNarrowing(parent, child); actions[].expected is checkTaskConstraints(mandates[mandate], request) (null = permitted). Keys are the RFC 8032 §7.1 test keys — never use them for anything real.

expected.reason: Task mandate issuedAt 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z is in the future
Malformed token: taskConstraints.onBehalfOf must be a non-empty string

narrowing.name: drops-room

narrowing.name: changes-onBehalfOf

narrowing.name: adds-capability

narrowing.name: drops-blocked

narrowing.name: write-only-to-read

narrowing.name: omits-compute-field
narrowing.expectedReason: Cannot attenuate task mandate: parent sets computeLimit.webRequests (40) but child omits it

narrowing.name: outlives-parent
narrowing.expectedReason: Cannot attenuate task mandate: child expiry (2099-01-01T00:00:00.001Z) extends beyond parent (2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z)

narrowing.name: hybrid-spend-widened
narrowing.expectedReason: Cannot attenuate task mandate: spendingConstraints: Cannot attenuate task → task: child spendLimitUsd (500) exceeds parent (420.07)

narrowing.name: hybrid-invariant-param-changed
narrowing.expectedReason: Cannot attenuate task mandate: child parameter "refundable" does not match parent's fixed value

narrowing.name: empty-dataAccess-dropped
narrowing.expectedReason: Cannot attenuate task mandate: parent restricts dataAccess but child omits it

narrowing.name: empty-dataAccess-widened
narrowing.expectedReason: Cannot attenuate task mandate: child dataAccess["email"] (read) exceeds parent (none)

narrowing.name: empty-payee-dropped

narrowing.name: empty-payee-widened
narrowing.expectedReason: Cannot attenuate task mandate: child payee "did:aroha:airline" is not in parent's payee list
